title: Projection gaps separate into epistemic and cognitive dimensions

dimensions.epistemic_gap: missing measurement, causal, provenance, or validation connection between model and reality
dimensions.cognitive_gap: connection exists but is too compressed for the intended human to reconstruct reliably

quadrants.low_epistemic_high_cognitive: insert intermediate representations and test reconstruction
quadrants.high_epistemic_low_cognitive: collect/validate evidence and preserve UNKNOWN; do not explain around the gap

invariant: Explanatory refinement cannot repair missing empirical evidence, and additional empirical evidence does not automatically make a representation understandable.
boundary: The normalized scores and threshold are controller variables, not validated psychological or statistical measures.
